dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, Paimon really doesn't know where to start...

choices.text: So many effects to keep track of.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Don't worry about it. I know I'm asking quite a lot from you two. You must be busy with your other orders as well. When you've got that much on your plate, it's easy to slip up here and there.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Just take it one step at a time, and you're sure to figure it out. I believe in you.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Take as much time as you need, okay? I'm going to head back to the Winery for now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, sure was nice of Diluc to encourage us like that... Let's work extra hard so we won't let him down!

choices.text: It's so hard to find the right combination!
